objective: Increase legitimate BUKLOD Android full-screen AdMob monetization opportunities by removing fixed eight-minute interstitial wait and five-ads-per-session quota while retaining Google-compliant at-least-two completed distinct actions between interstitials, remote controls and sensitive-route protections.
productionBaselineEvidence: GitHub main 5d8214355a8a5ea12ecfd5c0c1e520fe4e263944; current policy uses INTERSTITIAL_MIN_EVENT_COUNT default 2, INTERSTITIAL_COOLDOWN_MS 480000ms (min 60000ms), INTERSTITIAL_SESSION_CAP 5. AdMob official policy https://support.google.com/admob/answer/6201362 explicitly disallows showing full-screen interstitial after every single user action and more than one per two user actions or two back-to-back ads. No production OTA has been published for this isolated change.
chosenApproach: Fix code to use two eligible completed actions, no fixed elapsed-time gating and no per-session quota; keep diagnostics counter but not as a limit. Serialize async reservation checks and hold interstitial lock until durable count reset; fail closed on missing storage persistence to prevent consecutive ads; keep SDK readiness, remote kill switches, interaction locks, and natural-break placements.
selectionRationale: Google AdMob disallows exactly every action, so adopt the highest supported two-action cadence and remove artificial 8-minute/5-session restrictions. Preserve user task completion independence and avoid double shows from concurrent callback races.
alternativeApproaches: Present interstitial after every eligible action and no safety checks: rejected, expressly prohibited by AdMob policy and can trigger invalid activity or ad serving restrictions.
Keep current 8-minute cooldown and five/session quota: rejected for being unnecessarily restrictive with already compliant two-event gating.
Remove fixed time/session quota but retain 2-event min plus atomic reservation and persist lock: selected.
preserveBehaviors: No fullscreen ad after every click, swipe, back, navigation or other single action; min two eligible successful actions per impression opportunity
Only server-committed natural-break stage completion triggers; no ads in active quiz, chat, PTT, call, account, form or high-risk screens
Remote feature flags, user consent and ad-light pass remain authoritative
Rewarded ads, banner/native placements, Wall ad cadence and all nonad functionality unchanged
No ad click/impression fabrication; missing inventory never blocks completion
Native Android runtime 1.3.2 and ad unit IDs unchanged
Failed persistent state reset prevents further consecutive interstitials, even without fixed cap
acceptanceChecks: Node 22 focused tests pass including nine possible shows in same timestamp at every two completions, not after every single action
Controller fails closed on duplicate concurrent completion attempts and failed durable reset
No reference to previous wall-clock lastShown or session cap enforcement remains in controller
AdMob preloading still used; actual full-screen ad must be loaded and eligible
Engineering Accountability, TypeScript, and web compatibility QA pass before merge
DEV/PR only until frozen RC and Android production OTA release ID verified
Revenue uplift not assumed without post-release AdMob report
